typography.fonts: System defaults (Inter, SF Pro) for an Apple-minimalist aesthetic.

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-lg for floating elements.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-full for pill buttons and FABs.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use white background for standard cards. For sticky toolbars, use Apple-style glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl).

CorrectionModeTrigger.design: Circular button (h-14 w-14) with soft shadow (shadow-lg), white background, and a Saffron or gray pencil/edit icon. Avoids header crowding.

ConfirmationDialog.design: Apple-style alert. Title: 'Enter Correction Mode?', Description: 'You are about to edit the horoscope details. Kattam charts will remain read-only.', Actions: 'Cancel' (ghost), 'Enter Mode' (Saffron primary).

ActiveModeToolbar.design: Glassmorphism background (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl) with a top border. Contains 'Exit' (ghost button, left) and 'Review' (Saffron pill button, right).

layouts.mobile_constraints: Designed strictly for 320–430pt screens. The header is untouched. All new controls are moved to the bottom (FAB and Bottom Toolbar) to maintain the minimalist top section.

motion.toolbar: Slide-in from bottom (translate-y-full to translate-y-0) with spring animation.
motion.dialog: Fade-in and subtle scale-up (scale-95 to scale-100).
motion.interactions: Active states on buttons scale down slightly (active:scale-95).

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all buttons (FAB, Review, Exit, Cancel, Confirm).
accessibility.contrast: Saffron (#F58220) with white text may need a slightly darker shade or bold text to pass APCA/WCAG contrast ratios.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for the FAB ('Enter Correction Mode').

instructions_to_main_agent: Remove the existing triple-tap logic to enter Correction Mode.
Add the CorrectionModeTrigger (FAB) to the Horoscope Results view.
Wire the FAB to trigger the Shadcn AlertDialog for confirmation.
Upon confirmation, toggle the app state to Correction Mode.
When in Correction Mode, hide the FAB and display the ActiveModeToolbar at the bottom.
Ensure Kattam charts remain strictly read-only while Rasi, planetary, and Palan cards become editable.
Do NOT add buttons to the header.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Ensure Apple-minimalist feel with generous padding (p-4 to p-6) and refined borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds where content underlaps.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped, rounded-full) with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, active, focus).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
